notes: Used to discover candidate registry entities, aliases, historical-region labels and approximate modern locations.
Not accepted as evidence for archaeological chronology or interpretive claims.
Imported rows require reconciliation because the catalogue contains unresolved locations, inconsistent chronology and duplicate or variant entries.
Imports are pinned to a specific Wikipedia revision so later catalogue changes can be reviewed explicitly instead of silently changing DAHA data.
